title: Very soft towels
text:
Very soft towels. I love these towels! Yes it did take a couple of washings to get rid of the lint problem but they still remain so soft. I haven't had any problems with the seams coming apart.
I'm going to order more today. :)

product_metadata.title: Martex Egyptian Bath Towel 2-Pk, Navy
features: Set of 2 bath towels made from premium fibers
Generously proportioned and offered in a range of fashionable colors
description: Martex, the brand name symbolic of quality towels, debuts its new 100% Egyptian cotton loops, 10 fashion-forward shades in THE towel for heavy duty drying with lush loops of this superior cotton. Large bath, hand and washcloth.

Cottony soft and plush, these towels from Martex make bath time a decadent experience. Made from ultra-fine Egyptian cotton and hemmed with lock stitches to prevent unraveling, the towels are remarkable for their style, softness and durability. Because the designers at Martex have created this towel set in a wide range of shades, you'll have no trouble finding some to match your décor. The all-cotton fibers produce towels that dry more effectively than those made from poly/cotton blends. In addition, you'll note that the towels become softer and more absorbent with repeated washings. These towels coordinate with hand towels and washcloths from Martex, making it easy for you to update your bathroom décor without blowing your decorating budget.
